Patient identifier.

parameters.name: examIds
parameters.description:
Filter by laboratory exam identifiers. Send multiple values as a comma-separated list (e.g. `examIds=1,2,3`).

**Referenced Table:** EXAME_LABORATORIO
**Referenced Column:** NR_SEQ_EXAME

parameters.name: includeParentExamIds
parameters.description:
Include exams whose parent exam identifier matches the provided list. Send multiple values as a comma-separated list.

**Referenced Table:** EXAME_LABORATORIO
**Referenced Column:** NR_SEQ_SUPERIOR

parameters.name: excludeExamIds
parameters.description:
Exclude exams whose identifier is in the provided list. Send multiple values as a comma-separated list.

**Referenced Table:** EXAME_LABORATORIO
**Referenced Column:** NR_SEQ_EXAME

parameters.name: onlyWithMaterial
parameters.description:
When `YES`, returns only exam results that have an associated material/specimen; `NO` or omitted returns all.

**Possible values:**
- `YES`: only results with an associated material/specimen.
- `NO`: no restriction.

parameters.name: onlyEpimedDepartment
parameters.description:
When `YES`, restricts results to encounters whose department is flagged for EPIMED integration.

**Possible values:**
- `YES`: only encounters from EPIMED-flagged departments.
- `NO`: no restriction.

parameters.name: excludeZeroOrEmptyResults
parameters.description:
When `YES`, filters out exams whose result value is empty or equals zero.

**Possible values:**
- `YES`: exclude zero or empty results.
- `NO`: keep all results.

parameters.name: onlyNumericResults
parameters.description:
When `YES`, returns only results whose value can be interpreted as a number.

**Possible values:**
- `YES`: only numeric results.
- `NO`: no restriction.

parameters.name: equipmentAcronym
parameters.description:
Filter by the laboratory equipment acronym that produced the result.
